name: Astral Mechanics (Psionic)
body:
Prerequisites(s): Technologist*, ability to manifest astral construct.

Benefit(s): When you manifest astral construct, you may instead manifest an astral robot. Astral robots are identical to astral constructs, save that they have an intelligence score of 10, a number of skill points equal to twice their Hit Dice, and the robot subtype. The robot treats any skills you have ranks in as class skills. This does not grant the astral robot any robot upgrades or feats.
